players.product: FCBGA substrate for AI accelerators & server CPUs

quarterly_data.signal: Package substrate supply contract with an undisclosed large global company (counterparty and main terms withheld for business confidentiality at the counterparty's request until 12-31-2027, to be disclosed the next business day after that); term 01-01-2027 to 12-31-2027, signed 10-18-2026; supply region not stated; no down payment. Amount converted from USD 267,325,000 at the first posted rate on the contract date (KRW 1,348.50 per USD); the company notes amount and term may change in the course of business.
